name: ICC-Crawler

operator.name: National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT)

description: The web crawler of the Universal Communication Research Institute at Japan's National Institute of Information and Communications Technology. It collects web pages for NICT's research and development of information processing technologies including multilingual translation, information analysis and artificial intelligence, and NICT states that collected information and research products may be provided to third parties for joint or further research. The crawler page documents a load policy that caps connections per unit of time across a host's several addresses or hostnames.
